item.title: After an 85% surge in 6 months, HSBC sees another 28% upside in jewellery stock Kalyan Jewellers; up 878% in 5 years
item.description: HSBC maintains a Buy rating on Kalyan Jewellers, setting a target price of ₹830—28% above its recent close. It cites resilient jewellery demand and growth potential from affordable brand ATM, whose successful expansion could add earnings upside not yet included in estimates.

item.title: Why is RBI moving gold back to India? What Russia's frozen reserves and 1991 crisis reveal
item.description: The RBI's latest half-yearly report shows that its domestic gold holdings rose to 740.13 metric tonnes at the end of September 2026, compared with 680.05 metric tonnes at the end of March 2026.
